title: Is the reaction feasible?
caption: ΔG = ΔH − TΔS must be negative. The signs of ΔH and ΔS decide whether that depends on temperature.
alt: A tree: is ΔH negative? Then: is ΔS positive? Feasible at all temperatures; otherwise only at low temperatures. If ΔH is positive: is ΔS positive? Feasible at high temperatures; otherwise never.
description: ΔH negative and ΔS positive: always feasible, such as combustion.
ΔH negative and ΔS negative: feasible below T = ΔH/ΔS, such as the Haber process.
ΔH positive and ΔS positive: feasible above T = ΔH/ΔS, such as decomposing CaCO₃.
ΔH positive and ΔS negative: never feasible.
